series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a downward trend with moderate strength and weak seasonality, but high noise (spectral entropy >0.85) and unpredictability. Concept drift and model redundancy suggest avoiding complex combinations. A robust baseline approach (e.g., median) is recommended to handle the unstable rankings and high noise.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true → high noise and unpredictability; robust_median is less sensitive to outliers and provides stable forecasts in noisy environments
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure and leverages model-specific strengths
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.3216) → unstable rankings; inverse_rmse_weights with shrinkage provides robustness by downweighting poor performers while avoiding overfitting
